name: Solar Prism Canyon
description: A canyon whose walls are made of crystalline prisms that split sunlight into dancing rainbows across the floor.
prompt: A deep canyon with towering walls composed of massive natural crystal prisms. Midday sun streams through, splitting into brilliant rainbows that dance across the sandy floor and mist. Photorealistic, high contrast, 8k.
caption: Sunlight shattered into a thousand colors. 🌞🌈
